source_description: Revised Statutes of the United States, 1st edition (1875), §1979. Text reconstructed from the source credits in 42 USC §1983 ('R.S. § 1979') confirmed against secondary sources.
secondary_sources_consulted: Monroe v. Pape, 365 U.S. 167 (1961) (reproduces R.S. §1979 text in full)
retrieval_steward: Claude (assistant) under steward direction — Michael Hartmann
notes: The R.S. §1979 text is the version that was dormant from 1874 to 1961 and was revived by Monroe v. Pape. The text as given here represents the statute AFTER codification but BEFORE the 1979 and 1996 amendments.
